docker.name: Docker Engine Management
docker.description: Comprehensive container lifecycle management, live log inspection, container restart/start/stop, image listing and automated cache/layer pruning over MCP protocol.

all_tools.name: list_containers
all_tools.description: List all Docker containers (running and stopped) with status, ports, and names.

all_tools.name: get_container_logs
all_tools.description: Fetch live or historical stdout/stderr logs from a specific Docker container.

params.container_name: string (required) - Name or ID of the container
params.tail: integer (optional) - Number of lines from the end of the logs

all_tools.name: restart_container
all_tools.description: Restart a running or stopped Docker container.

params.container_name: string (required) - Name or ID of the container to restart

all_tools.name: start_container
all_tools.description: Start a stopped Docker container.

params.container_name: string (required) - Name or ID of the container to start

all_tools.name: stop_container
all_tools.description: Stop a running Docker container.

params.container_name: string (required) - Name or ID of the container to stop
params.timeout: integer (optional) - Seconds to wait before stopping

all_tools.name: inspect_container
all_tools.description: Retrieve detailed JSON inspection metadata for a container.

params.container_name: string (required) - Name or ID of the container

all_tools.name: list_images
all_tools.description: List all Docker images available locally on the host.

all_tools.name: prune_images
all_tools.description: Remove unused, dangling, and unreferenced Docker images to reclaim disk space.

all_tools.name: get_docker_system_info
all_tools.description: Display host-wide Docker system information.
